messages.subject: Re: rattle freezes on descriptives
messages.body_plain:
I ran the audit data set and rattle froze again on either skew or
basic statistics (running xppro by the way).  Rattle froze just after
loading fBasics().  R console still runs, but not rattle.

If I library(Rmetrics) prior to running rattle(),  it does not freeze
on either skew or basics. So that fixes the problem in my case.

Thanks for getting back to me.
Neil
